# tests/fixtures/skeleton/population.bad.yaml
# Violating population:
#   - movie 1 has TWO title facts        -> alethic uniqueness  -> fail
#   - movie 3 has NO title fact          -> alethic mandatory   -> fail (closed-world)
#   - year 1520 out of [1888, 2100]      -> deontic value range -> warning
population:
  model: model.orm.yaml
  source: fixture
  label: violating
  covers: [movie_has_title, movie_released_in_year]
instances:
  movie: [1, 2, 3]
facts:
  movie_has_title:
    - { movie: 1, title: "The Departed" }
    - { movie: 1, title: "Also The Departed" }
    - { movie: 2, title: "Inception" }
  movie_released_in_year:
    - { movie: 1, year: 1520 }

# tests/fixtures/skeleton/population.good.yaml
# Conforming population: every movie has exactly one title, years in range, one sequel pair.
population:
  model: model.orm.yaml
  source: fixture
  label: conforming
  covers: [movie_has_title, movie_released_in_year, movie_sequel_of_movie]
instances:
  movie: [1, 2]
facts:
  movie_has_title:
    - { movie: 1, title: "The Departed" }
    - { movie: 2, title: "Infernal Affairs" }
  movie_released_in_year:
    - { movie: 1, year: 2006 }
    - { movie: 2, year: 2002 }
  movie_sequel_of_movie:
    - { sequel: 1, original: 2 }
